result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 (Administrative Code), covering city department powers and duties (Government Affairs, Executive Services, Independent Budget Analyst, Development Services, Planning, Economic Development, Risk Management), with no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part of the document (San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 2, Article 2, Divisions 19-26) contains only municipal administrative provisions about city departments and officers. Although the source URL refers to the algorithmic rent-setting prohibition (Division 11, § 98.1103), the text of that provision does not appear in this part, so no in-scope rule can be extracted.
